Essential Question: 2. Are eligible children enrolled in quality, full-day pre-K programs?
Metric: Percentage of eligible 3- and 4-year-olds enrolled in public pre-K
Notes: Must be cross referenced with grade level
CEDS Queries V11:
select
        'Number of Students (Grade PK)' AS DataElementName,
    'RecordCount' AS CharacteristicType,
        CAST(COUNT(*) AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS Value,
    NULL AS Remarks
    from
        RDS.FactK12StudentEnrollments f
       join RDS.DimPeople p on p.DimPersonId = f.K12StudentId
        join RDS.DimGradeLevels g on f.EntryGradeLevelId = g.DimGradeLevelId
    where
         g.GradeLevelCode in ('PK') and p.IsActiveELChild=1

WITH total_students AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(1),0) AS total, f.SchoolYearId
    FROM rds.FactK12StudentCourseSections f

    WHERE g.GradeLevelCode IN ('09', '10', '11', '12')
    GROUP BY f.SchoolYearId
),

    SELECT f.SchoolYearId, COUNT(DISTINCT f.K12StudentId) AS ap_count
    FROM rds.FactK12StudentCourseSections f
    JOIN RDS.DimGradeLevels g ON f.EntryGradeLevelId = g.DimGradeLevelId
    JOIN RDS.DimK12CourseStatuses cs ON cs.DimK12CourseStatusId = f.K12CourseStatusId
    JOIN rds.FactK12StudentAssessments ase ON f.K12StudentId = ase.K12StudentId 
        AND f.SchoolYearId = ase.SchoolYearId
    JOIN RDS.DimAssessments da ON da.DimAssessmentId = ase.AssessmentId
    WHERE g.GradeLevelCode IN ('09', '10', '11', '12')
      AND cs.CourseLevelCharacteristicCode = '00574'
      AND da.AssessmentTitle = 'Advanced Placement test'
      AND ase.AssessmentResultScoreValueRawScore IS NOT NULL
      AND da.AssessmentAcademicSubjectCode IN ('13371','13372','73088','73089','13374','00554','00560','13373','01166','00562','73086','73087','01287')
    GROUP BY f.SchoolYearId
),
anchor AS (
    SELECT 1 AS dummy
)

    'Percentage of students enrolled in AP course' AS DataElementName,
    'Percentage' AS CharacteristicType,
    COALESCE(ap.ap_count * 100.0 / t.total, 0) AS Value,
    NULL AS Remarks
FROM anchor a
LEFT JOIN total_students t ON 1 = 1
LEFT JOIN ap_students ap ON t.SchoolYearId = ap.SchoolYearId;

WITH CategorizedStudents AS (
    -- Categorize each student into an Age Group
    SELECT
        d.DimPersonId,
        CASE
            -- Calculate Age based on the difference in years between BirthDate and today
            WHEN DATEDIFF(year, d.BirthDate, GETDATE()) < 5 THEN 'Early Childhood'
            WHEN DATEDIFF(year, d.BirthDate, GETDATE()) BETWEEN 5 AND 17 THEN 'School Age'
            WHEN DATEDIFF(year, d.BirthDate, GETDATE()) BETWEEN 18 AND 24 THEN 'Young Adult'
            ELSE 'Adult Learner' -- 25+ years
        END AS CalculatedAgeGroup
    FROM
        RDS.DimPeople d
    JOIN
        RDS.FactK12StudentEnrollments f ON f.K12StudentId = d.DimPersonId
    JOIN
        RDS.FactPsStudentEnrollments ff ON ff.PsStudentId = d.DimPersonId
    WHERE
        d.BirthDate IS NOT NULL
)
-- Step 2: Select the desired output columns and filter/count the records
SELECT
    'Age group' AS DataElementName,
    'RecordCount' AS CharacteristicType,
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS Value,
    NULL AS Remarks
FROM
    CategorizedStudents
WHERE
    CalculatedAgeGroup = 'School Age';
